notes: Curated eval for multi-source field synthesis. Output checks require observation vs recommendation and source-breadth scoring. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.
I need help with a defined corpus of rep notes, manager feedback, call excerpts, surveys, CRM comments, or support signals.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable field feedback and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please audit revenue enablement content coverage and prioritize the highest-impact gaps by role, stage, and use case.
Please synthesize win-loss interviews, notes, and deal evidence into clear themes and actions.
Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.

output_structure_checks.name: field-feedback-coverage
output_structure_checks.description: States counting unit, denominator, source mix, exclusions, and independent-source breadth.

output_structure_checks.name: field-feedback-observation-vs-recommendation
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps observation, interpretation, root-cause hypothesis, and recommendation distinct on material themes.

output_structure_checks.name: field-feedback-breadth-score
output_structure_checks.description: Scores confidence from source breadth rather than from frequency in one channel.

output_structure_checks.name: field-feedback-no-invention
output_structure_checks.description: Does not invent usage, win rates, or quotes, or produce a content backlog or governed objection library.

output_structure_checks.name: field-feedback-synthesizer-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Without a trustworthy denominator, offers supported qualitative findings and their limits instead of inventing prevalence or withholding all analysis.
